mobbin:b5d1550e-5945-48c2-97c4-e12e9ea63.summary: The user turns on In-Person Recorder in Settings, starts a floating background recording with a live waveform, then lands on a Meeting Overview with transcript, share targets and short playback.
steps: In-Person Recorder on, with record button
Recording in progress with timer and waveform
steal: Settings has its own 'In-Person Recorder' switch, so recording a conversation in the room is a clear mode, not a one-off (screens 1 to 2).
A floating recorder with a timer, sound wave and stop button stays on screen while the user moves around the app (screens 3 to 4).
After the session, an overview shows a transcript link, sharing to Slack, email or notes, and playback with 'See Transcription' (screen 5).
When the AI finds nothing to do, the to-do list says 'No actions, you're in the clear!' (screen 5).
avoid: No consent or permission prompt appears when enabling or starting in-person recording, but the baseline needs consent before capturing faculty or group speech.
mobbin:b5d1550e-5945-48c2-97c4-e12e9ea63.fit: Debrief and review: a strong pattern for a phone voice-memo fallback beside the debrief room. Add consent before record and attach output to the session report.
